question: What topics are covered in the fifteenth chapter on becoming an initiate?
premises: The fifteenth chapter concerns the rite of becoming an initiate.
It treats contemplation of the self of the maṇḍala.
It treats the elaboration of the offered animal victim.
inference: Chapter 15 links maṇḍala contemplation with the ritual offering of the victim.
uncertainties: paśu here is a ritual term and may be symbolic or literal depending on context.
plain_english: In the fifteenth chapter, on the rite of becoming an initiate, contemplation of the self of the maṇḍala and the elaboration of the offered victim are covered.
